findings.description: is_palindrome compares original string s with s[::-1] instead of cleaned with cleaned[::-1], so it fails for mixed-case or space-containing palindromes. The function does not actually use the cleaned variable, defeating the intended normalization logic.

fix_description: Change the return statement in is_palindrome to compare the cleaned string: return cleaned == cleaned[::-1]. This ensures the normalization (lowercasing and removing spaces) is actually used, allowing mixed-case and spaced palindromes to be detected correctly.
